mapper.sql: m.id, m.name, m.path, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.used_yn, m.created_at, m.updated_at, p.id AS p_id, p.name AS p_name, p.path AS p_path, p.icon AS p_icon, p.sort_order AS p_sort_order, p.used_yn AS p_used_yn, p.created_at AS p_created_at, p.updated_at AS p_updated_at
FROM app_menu m LEFT JOIN app_menu p ON p.id = m.parent_id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT WHERE m.id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_menu (parent_id, name, path, icon, sort_order, used_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{parent.id}, #{name}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{used}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
